page.notes: The italic phrase "Sed fidelis]" stands inside the text block at the start of the second paragraph, not in a margin, so it is kept as running text. The bracket after it is copied as printed. Doubtful readings: "serio" (printed "ferio", long s assumed), "beftiis" and "feris" (f kept as printed), "fieri" (f kept as printed). The phrase "iftiusmo-di homines,proterviam,inquam,hanc" repeats "proterviam" as printed. The small mark to the right of "nobis," on the first line is a printer's mark, not text. The bottom of the page has no catchword; the text ends on the hyphenated "proxi-" line above the signature.
